gloss: good plan; good idea; wise strategy

definitions.gloss: good plan; good idea; wise strategy; good measure
definitions.explanation: A plan, strategy, or course of action that is considered effective and well-thought-out. Often used in the negative to say there is no good solution.

examples.japanese: ⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧{良策|りょうさく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つからない→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: I can't seem to find a good plan.
I wouldn't call that a good idea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}する→解消する：21324_kaishousuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{良策|りょうさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}している→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{難航|なんこう}している→難航する：19360_nankousuru⟧。
examples.english: We are considering good strategies to relieve traffic congestion, but progress is difficult due to budget issues.

notes:
Composed of {良|りょう} (good) + ⟦{策|さく}→策：09997_saku⟧ (plan, strategy). A somewhat formal word often encountered in discussions of policy, business strategy, and problem-solving. Notably common in negative contexts — {良策|りょうさく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (there's no good plan) is a frequent pattern.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {良策|りょうさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つける→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧ — to find a good plan
- {良策|りょうさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ — to think of a good plan
- {良策|りょうさく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ — there is no good plan
- {良策|りょうさく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{言|い}えない→言う：00515_iu⟧ — cannot be called a good plan

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{妙案|みょうあん}→妙案：23888_myouan⟧ — brilliant idea; more creative, implies cleverness
- ⟦{名案|めいあん}→名案：15591_meian⟧ — excellent idea; emphasizes the quality of the idea
- ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ — countermeasure; neutral, doesn't imply good or bad
- ⟦{方策|ほうさく}→方策：16892_housaku⟧ — policy, strategy; more formal, used in government/business
